rows.caveat: #7701 router cell test, NO STORED TEXT: one interior page with no OCR per book (30 books) in the first-read lane's frame (visible books held as scans only, print route, no manuscript by library/title/date, no possible unsplit spread), read fresh by agy Flash-low as the lane reads it, judged blind by Opus against the image (wrong-page controls passed). Arm B (Derek 2026-10-29: read, then correct in a second pass) on the same pages: the read, then the #7558 correction pass on it; where it gave no correction the page serves the read. Two rows per arm: agy-flash-low@4 counts every drawn page (a filter-cut or failed read is not accepted, the #7517 convention); agy-flash-low@4-written only the pages the lane writes (delivered and past apply --first-read-only --print-only). A page not written stays scans-only, which is the current route: the decision rule fixed before judging (RULE.md beside the score) is the written row's wrong text <= 4% and P(acc >= 0.8) >= 0.9.
